alive.last_commit_message:
chore(guinea-pigs): keep only the deliberately vulnerable targets

The guinea pigs that proved one fix or one feature, with no vulnerability
to find, are removed: ai_surface_target, auth_target,
circuit_breaker_target, fix_regression_target, jev_target, js_scope_target,
node_filters_lab, tls_target and vhost_target. The fixes and features keep
their unit and regression tests. Gone with them: the vhost live test and the
Playwright auth-recording spec that needed a running lab, the
ai_surface_target triage-truth entry, and the lab rows in the indexes.
Comments that named a lab as the place a bug was found now describe it.

Kept: the Apache CVE servers, dvws-node, node-serialize, the five HTTP
desync stacks, waf-bypass, web-cache-poisoning, proxy_brain_target,
serialized_target and supply_chain_target.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
